summary: Cycad was a Nomai geology apprentice under Coleus who worked on sourcing ore from Timber Hearth for the Ash Twin Project's supernova-resistant shell. He was known among the Nomai clan for his habit of making puns.

location: Cycad moved with Coleus and Oeno to Timber Hearth to mine ore for the Ash Twin Project's shell.
Cycad died when Ghost Matter from the Interloper killed all Nomai in the solar system.
lore: Cycad was Coleus's apprentice in geology.
Cycad pointed out during a Nomai discussion that Coleus and Melorae's anglerfish-fossil research could allow Nomai to safely return to Dark Bramble.
Coleus reminded Cycad that the anglerfish-blindness hypothesis had never been tested on a living specimen.
Cycad initially believed Timber Hearth's ore would be used to build the remaining warp towers on Ash Twin.
Oeno explained to Cycad that the Timber Hearth ore was destined only for the Ash Twin Project's protective shell, not the warp towers.
Cycad proposed mining site 2b after site 2a was deemed unsafe for the native Hearthian-ancestor life in the cave pools.
Cycad was fascinated by the semi-aquatic native life on Timber Hearth and would watch them for hours.
Cycad had a habit of making puns, which Oeno disapproved of but which Coleus tolerated.
Cycad noted that the native Timber Hearth life had four eyes and wondered what the fourth eye was for.
